summary: The traditional floor-pickup prompt accepts ':' to inspect the available objects and then repeat the prompt. C calls pickup.c:simple_look from query_classes; JS refuses at its unported simple_look placeholder, stopping the selected command before the look output and prompt continuation.

source.branch: query_classes receives ':' from the traditional object-class prompt and calls simple_look(objs, here), then returns to ask_again. simple_look reports a lone object with pline1(doname(...)); for a list it writes each doname result to an NHW_MENU text window and blocks for display dismissal.
callers: pickup.c:pickup calls query_classes for floor objects after constructing the class prompt; the selected case uses this path.
pickup.c:traditional_loot calls query_classes for inventory put-in and container take-out selection. The independent recording exercises its put-in caller.
dependencies: query_classes uses collect_obj_classes, count_unpaid, tally_BUCX, and display_inventory; the corresponding JS implementations already exist. The ':' branch uses display_inventory only for the separate 'i' choice, whose C result is discarded.
